title: Ukrainian Chicken Pilaf
description: A hearty, comforting pilaf dish filled with chicken, herbs, and nutty undertones. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Nutty
ingredients.notes: Chopped nuts such as almonds or walnuts

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add pilaf, thyme, salt, and pepper to skillet. Stir to combine.
Add chicken broth to skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Stir in chicken and cook until heated through.
Garnish with chopped nuts and serve hot.
